deliverable.title: Science, art and shared wonder
deliverable.theme: Notice something familiar, ask a plain-language science question about it, then compare what different people see.
deliverable.attendance_plan: At every public interval, assign no more than 80 people across concurrent room rows: Hall/Quiet 60+20, then Hall/Courtyard/Quiet 20+40+20, later 40+20+20. Quiet space stays available; the quiet-room host is assigned 18:30–20:30. Allocate the included 80 movable chairs initially as 60 Hall and 20 Quiet; move 40 Hall chairs to the Courtyard during 19:00–19:15, then move 20 Courtyard chairs to the Hall during 19:45–20:00. The 15-minute moves also give attendees time to change rooms. Stewards direct people along the confirmed step-free route; keep aisles and exits clear. This chair plan needs a floor-plan and handling-time check.

programme.title: Setup: room, quiet-space and wayfinding set-out; chair count and access-route check
Welcome, plain-language framing and access/wayfinding orientation
Short science talks and conversation: two speakers, familiar examples, no audience experiments
Guided room change and chair transfer: 40 people and chairs move from Hall to Courtyard
Guided room change and chair transfer: Courtyard arrival
Art and observation workshop: look, sketch and compare; reusable viewing cards
Guided room change and chair transfer: 20 people and chairs move from Courtyard to Hall
Guided room change and chair transfer: Hall arrival
Light refreshments and informal conversation, with service staged for the Hall and Courtyard
Pack-down, chair inventory and clear-room check

staff_assignments: Volunteer lead facilitator (3h, 18:00–21:00): coordinate setup, welcome, transitions, close and pack-down.
Two science speakers (1.5h each, 18:15–19:45): prepare and deliver short talks; one may support the workshop handoff.
Two arrival/wayfinding stewards (3h each, 18:00–21:00): welcome, step-free wayfinding, count room occupancy, direct transitions and help move chairs while maintaining clear routes.
Quiet-room host (2h, 18:30–20:30): host quiet space and sensory kit; confirm whether remaining 15 minutes of public time can be covered or whether the quiet room must close to hosted use at 20:30.
alternatives: If courtyard availability or the 40-chair transfer cannot be confirmed, run the observation workshop in the Hall in two groups of up to 40, one after the other; retain the Quiet Room at up to 20 and stagger Hall attendance so total attendance never exceeds 80. This adds a second workshop block and needs a revised schedule and staffing check.
If weather or comfort conditions make the covered courtyard unsuitable, use the same Hall rotation alternative; do not increase room capacity.
assumptions: The 80 included chairs can be moved between rooms by the two stewards and lead, and the route is short, step-free and wide enough to keep access clear during the 15-minute transitions.
The quiet room is open and hosted from 18:30 to 20:30; quiet provision after that time through 20:45 requires a human staffing decision.
The fictional support-card volunteer roles are available for the listed hours; this is not a real availability claim.
Refreshments can be staged in the Hall and Courtyard and served to their combined 60 attendees; quiet-room use remains food-free and separate.
unresolved_questions: Can the venue floor plan support 60 Hall chairs, 20 Quiet Room chairs, and transfer of 40 chairs to and from the Courtyard in each 15-minute window while keeping step-free routes and exits clear?
Can a quiet-room host cover the full public window, or should the quiet option end at 20:30? The source plan provides two host-hours.
Should the quiet room remain food-free, and can the refreshment service be staged across Hall and Courtyard without a queue blocking circulation?
Confirm actual courtyard/weather conditions and the final accessible route before any real-world operation; this proposal creates no booking or commitment.

assumptions: All venue, price and support facts are invented and apply only to this local rehearsal.
open_questions: Verify chair movement, route clearance, refreshment service arrangement, and quiet-host coverage before any real event.
